description: This file defines the CalendarSyncConfig class, which manages configuration settings for calendar synchronization functionality in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for retrieving default and stored configuration values, setting new configurations, and handling various sync parameters such as concurrency limits, sync windows, conflict resolution strategies, and event deletion permissions.

classes.name: CalendarSyncConfig
classes.description: A class providing configuration management for calendar synchronization, such as retrieving, updating, and defaulting sync settings.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns all configuration keys.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves the entire configuration, merged with defaults.

methods.name: getMergedConfig
methods.description: Merges raw configuration data with default values.

methods.name: loadRawConfig
methods.description: Loads raw configuration data from the system.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Saves configuration values to persistent storage.

methods.name: getRunAsyncValue
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean indicating if asynchronous execution is enabled.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Fetches a specific configuration value.

methods.name: validateBoolean
methods.description: Converts a value to boolean with default fallback.

methods.name: getMaxAccountsPerSync
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of accounts per sync.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Converts a value to integer with default fallback.

methods.name: getMaxOperationsPerAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of operations per account.

methods.name: getSyncWindowPastDays
methods.description: Retrieves the number of days for the past sync window.

methods.name: getSyncWindowFutureDays
methods.description: Retrieves the number of days for the future sync window.

methods.name: getConflictResolution
methods.description: Gets the conflict resolution strategy.

methods.name: allowInternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Checks if internal event deletions are allowed.

methods.name: allowExternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Checks if external event deletions are allowed.

methods.name: enableCalendarSyncLogicHooks
methods.description: Checks if calendar sync logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Gets the external calendar name used in sync operations.

methods.name: validateString

methods.name: getLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last manual run timestamp, if set.

methods.name: setLastManualRunTime
